_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. The real tier map lives in the PRIVATE content package, at
$ROT_CONTENT_DIR/change/difficulty.json, next to the images it describes. Nothing in this
repo reads this file: ingest stamps difficulty from the content root (app/jobs/run.py), and
Settings.content_root never falls back to backend/content/ - it falls back to content/sample/.
It used to hold twenty real-looking keys from an earlier brief that was never shipped, and
scripts/build_change_manifest.py defaulted to reading it. That was a live trap: ingest only
stamps difficulty onto items that do not already carry one, so a manifest built against this
stale map would have silently overridden the real tiers. The default was removed 2026-08-27.
Difficulty is an ATTENTION property, not a size one: changes to the subject are found fast,
changes to background or incidental objects are much harder even when large, and changes
inside a repeating pattern are hardest of all because there is no landmark to compare
against. No pixel measurement can derive it, which is why it is authored rather than built.
